title: Called to the House
logline: A village monk is called to house after house where someone is close to death, walking the same roads again and again to sit with families he barely has time to know.

object.note: Object 8 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: When speed has done what it can, someone still comes: a village monk walking to house after house where someone is close to death.

thread_out.thread: Presence at the end of lives turns inward: a teacher's brief evening meetings on a silent retreat, trying to gauge how deep each student has gone.

requirements: A rural temple whose monk regularly performs this pastoral role and is willing to be followed
Families willing to have the monk's visit, not the dying person, filmed
Full, ongoing consent, with the dying person's own wishes given priority
